scientific_integrity: The calculation is an independently written algebraic argument from an established polar criterion. Exact symbolic checks support but do not replace the global proof; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The incidence decomposition is established only over an unspecified nonempty Zariski-open neighborhood of the Fermat parameter; exceptional nonzero parameters are not classified. The incidence scheme includes 24 special-fiber points on the quartic, which are not exterior quasi-Galois centers. Historical-priority uncertainty persists for unindexed results and a related Fermat-variety preprint examined at abstract level only.
title: Polar-reflection incidence at the Fermat member of the Dwork quartic pencil
